README: Every v3 policy that has been SCORED on a stratified sample of the 9,956-file corpus.
A record is {policy, evidence, sample_sha256, summary} and holds no CAD: hashes and numbers
only, never a corpus file name or path. Appended by `devtools/validation/gym.py record` -
never by hand, because a fingerprint nobody ran is worse than no record at all.
